alignments.note: Fronted nominal (casus pendens): construct noun with a supplied *the* (rule 29). The supplied *as for* is no longer part of this unit: no morpheme stands on the fronted phrase to license it, so it is its own `added` unit (rules 16, 30).

The supplied *as for* answers to no morpheme: the fronted דְּמוּת פְּנֵיהֶם carries no object marker and no preposition. Rule 16's limit applies as it does to an appositional *even* before a phrase no marker marks, and rule 30 leaves the expression `added`; it is not folded into the fronted noun to avoid that (rule 42's reasoning about a surplus *and*). Headed on *as* (rule 24). Contrast 10:13, where a real fronting לְ carries *As for*.
Explicit subject pronoun takes only its own English word; the copula goes to the predicate (rule 20).
Nominal predicate takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 20); the unit is discontinuous around the article's *the*.
The chain is rendered appositionally, *the river Chebar* (rule 28).
The object marker itself has no English word; the ASV's *themselves* realizes its suffix (rule 16).
Distributive אִישׁ rendered by the two-word *every one*, headed on *one* (rule 31).
The ASV compresses אֶל־עֵבֶר פָּנָיו to *straight forward*, leaving this preposition no English word (rule 40).
The noun of direction takes *straight*. Competing reading: fuse the whole phrase to *straight forward* under rule 30; I split it because *forward* answers specifically to פָּנֶה.
The ASV's *straight forward* writes no possessive for this suffix (rule 22).

review_notes: Reconciliation patch, the same one made in 10:10. The supplied *as for* is now its own `added` unit instead of joining דְּמוּת. No object marker and no preposition stands on the fronted phrase, so rule 16's limit and rule 30 leave the expression unlicensed, exactly as this chapter read the supplied appositional *even* of 10:12.
דְּמוּת keeps its own *likeness* together with the *the* supplied for the construct (rule 29); the rectum keeps *of ... faces* and its suffix *their* (rules 19, 18).

Unchanged: the copula on the predicate rather than the explicit pronoun subject (rule 20), the unrepresented object marker beside the suffix's *themselves* (rules 16, 18), and the split of אֶל־עֵבֶר פָּנָיו, which leaves the preposition and the suffix unrepresented.
Partition re-verified: 23 source ids across 24 units, all 29 target ids used exactly once.
